explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/444: for infinite A ⊆ ℕ and every k, is limsup_x max_{n<x} d_A(n) / (Σ_{n∈A∩[1,x)} 1/n)^k = ∞, with d_A(n) the number of a ∈ A dividing n? Answered yes by Erdős–Sárközy. divisorCount counts the elements of A among the positive divisors of n. The statement takes the max over n ∈ [1, ⌈x⌉) (excluding n = 0, which every a divides) and the reciprocal sum over A ∩ [1, ⌈x⌉), and sets the EReal limsup over real x to ⊤. Faithful.
